description: Proxies for technical debt that indicate PRAGMATIST likelihood (Enhancement 8)

legacy_system_keywords.rationale: Heavy legacy footprint limits ability to adopt new standards

cost_pressure_keywords.rationale: Cost pressure reduces discretionary technology investment

modernization_keywords.rationale: Modernization initiatives create foundation for CDM adoption

cdm_direct_keywords.rationale: Direct CDM hiring is strong ARCHITECT signal

organizational_proxies.description: Organizational signals that indicate technical debt

executive_turnover.description: High CTO/CIO turnover indicates strategy instability
executive_turnover.rationale: Strategy churn prevents long-term technology investment

financial_proxies.description: Financial indicators of technology investment capacity

it_spending_ratio.description: IT spending as percentage of revenue
it_spending_ratio.rationale: Low IT spending limits technology adoption capacity

cost_income_ratio.rationale: High cost/income ratio indicates cost pressure

legacy_vendor_relationships.rationale: Older platform versions indicate upgrade backlog

signal_aggregation.description: How to combine multiple proxy signals
signal_aggregation.notes: Combined score adjusts prior probability, not classification directly

usage_notes: Use debt_proxy_analyzer.py to scan for technical debt signals
Signals are secondary to direct CDM evidence
Multiple pragmatist signals compound the effect
Modernization initiatives can offset legacy signals
